products.title: Heavyweight Oversized Box Tee
products.subtitle: 280 GSM Combed Cotton · Drop-Shoulder Silhouette
products.description: The definitive everyday streetwear silhouette. Crafted from custom-knit 280 GSM combed cotton jersey, pre-shrunk with a vintage garment wash. Features an exaggerated drop-shoulder cut, structured rib collar that retains its shape, and clean double-needle hems.

details.fit: Boxy, oversized drop-shoulder cut. True to streetwear fit.
details.care: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors. Hang dry or tumble dry low.
details.modelStats: Model is 6'1" (185 cm) wearing size L.

products.title: 500 GSM French Terry Boxy Hoodie
products.subtitle: Heavyweight Custom Terry · Double Layer Hood · Zero Drawstrings
products.description: Engineered for sculptural presence and tactile comfort. Made with our heaviest 500 GSM custom-looped French Terry cotton. Designed without drawstrings for a pure minimalist neckline, deep kangaroo pocket, and rib-knit side gussets for mobility.

details.fit: Structured oversized fit with wide chest and relaxed sleeves.
details.care: Dry clean recommended or gentle cold machine wash.

products.title: Relaxed Pleated Cargo Trousers
products.subtitle: Tailored Heavy Twill · Magnetic Pocket Flaps · Straight Wide Leg
products.description: The intersection of sartorial tailoring and utilitarian functionalism. High-density cotton twill featuring tailored double-front pleats, flush-mount 3D cargo pockets with hidden magnetic closures, and adjustable cinch hems.

details.fabric: 340 GSM High-Density Cotton Twill with Stretch
details.fit: High-rise, relaxed through the thigh with gentle taper to hem.
details.care: Cool machine wash. Warm iron on reverse.
details.modelStats: Model is 6'1" wearing waist size 32 (Size M).

products.title: Brutalist Minimalist Zip Jacket
products.subtitle: Brushed Heavy Wool Blend · YKK Excella Two-Way Zip · Satin Lining
products.description: A structured outerwear piece balancing architectural lines with supreme insulation. Features dropped shoulders, clean welt pockets, and a matte gunmetal two-way zipper.

details.fabric: 60% Wool, 40% Technical Polyester, Cupro Satin Lining
details.fit: Slightly cropped boxy torso with generous sleeves.

products.title: 500 GSM Heavy Loopback Sweatpants
products.subtitle: Custom French Terry · Relaxed Tapered Leg · Heavy Ribbed Cuffs
products.description: The definitive luxury casual sweatpants. Engineered from 500 GSM custom-knit unbrushed French Terry cotton for weighted drape and shape retention. Features reinforced deep side slash pockets, back patch pocket, and thick elasticated waistband with elongated drawstrings.

details.fit: Relaxed through seat and thigh, slight taper to heavy ribbed cuff.
details.care: Machine wash cold inside-out. Flat dry.

products.title: Architectural Boxy Utility Overshirt
products.subtitle: 380 GSM High-Twist Twill · Matte Snap Fasteners · Chest Flap Pockets
products.description: An immaculate layering anchor designed for versatile styling over our heavy tees. Crafted from 380 GSM durable compact cotton twill with dual gusseted military flap chest pockets, stand collar, and concealed snap front placket.

details.fit: Square boxy silhouette cut intentionally broad across the shoulders.

products.title: Vanguard Raw Hem Acid Wash Tee
products.subtitle: 290 GSM Vintage Pigment Wash · Distressed Collar · Raw Bottom Hem
products.description: Each piece undergoes a 4-stage mineral enzyme wash to achieve authentic aged micro-textures without weakening the fibers. Finished with an intentional raw edge at the hemline that subtly rolls after washing.

details.fabric: 100% Combed Compact Cotton with Mineral Enzyme Wash
details.fit: Extreme boxy cut with wide elbow-length sleeves.
details.care: Wash cold inside-out. Do not bleach.

products.title: Dual-Zipper Heavyweight Boxy Hoodie
products.subtitle: 520 GSM Brushed Cotton Fleece · Heavy Gunmetal 2-Way Zip
products.description: The apex of technical casualwear. Constructed from ultra-heavy 520 GSM brushed-back fleece with a structured 3-panel hood that never sags. Features custom matte gunmetal double zippers allowing custom styling from top and bottom.

details.fit: Exaggerated boxy cut, ribbed dropped armholes, cropped at hip.
details.care: Dry clean or cold machine wash delicate.

products.title: Tailored Wide-Leg Pleated Trousers
products.subtitle: 350 GSM Wool-Touch Twill · Double Forward Pleats · Full Break Drape
products.description: Designed for fluid architectural movement. Tailored from a crease-resistant 350 GSM twill that drapes effortlessly over sneakers and boots. Features clean tab-fastener waistband, subtle side adjusters, and deep welt pockets.

details.fabric: 65% Poly, 35% Rayon Heavy Suiting Twill 350 GSM
details.fit: High-waisted, generous through the leg with fluid full break.
details.care: Dry clean recommended or cool delicate wash.

products.title: Monochrome Brutalist Co-ord Set
products.subtitle: Matching 450 GSM Oversized Crewneck & Relaxed Sweatpants
products.description: A comprehensive uniform for effortless styling. Combines our drop-shoulder boxy crewneck and matching tapered sweatpants, woven from matched-dye lot 450 GSM combed cotton. Includes custom silicone 4 LAZY tonal branding at the wrist and calf.

details.care: Machine wash cool. Dry flat in shade.

reviews.title: The best boxy cut in India
reviews.comment: The collar stays tight after washing, the drop shoulder is immaculate, and the 280 GSM weight feels substantial without feeling stiff. 10/10.

reviews.title: Worth every single rupee
reviews.comment: The 500 GSM fleece has so much structure. Doesn't collapse at the neck and looks so sculptural. Best streetwear purchase this season.

reviews.title: Unbelievable drape and comfort
reviews.comment: Heavyweight loopback feel that doesn't lose its taper. The pockets are deep enough for large phones without sagging.
